title: The ordered differential frame of an affine etale chart
statement: Let U,V be affine schemes, h:U→V smooth of pure relative dimension d, and c:U→A^d_V an etale V-map. There is an isomorphism from the free O_U-module on ULift(Fin d) to Ω_(U/V) taking generator i to d(c^*t_i). This includes d=0 and empty U [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf, def-sbc-affine-space, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

proof.text: The etale map on affine section rings identifies relative Kahler differentials with the base change of polynomial differentials. Tensor the polynomial coordinate basis, then use the affine comparison for differential sections. Extend the basis equivalence and its inverse to quasi-coherent sheaf morphisms and prove inverse identities on global sections.

theorem coordinate_differential_frame {U V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V]
    (d : ℕ) (h : U ⟶ V) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h] (c : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V)
    [Etale c] (hc : c ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V ↘ V) = h) :
    ∃ e : SheafOfModules.free (R := U.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) ≅
        h.relativeDifferentials,
      ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin d), e.hom.val.app (op ⊤)
        ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := U.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app (op ⊤)
          (1 : Γ(U, ⊤))) = h.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op ⊤)
            (c.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V i))
